data.name: Heya! Sumo Manager
data.detailed_description:
Heya! Sumo Manager is the management sim for sumo fans! Prove you have what it takes to train and manage your humble stable to the top division and the ultimate prize of Yokozuna! 

Featuring all 5 divisions and over 600 starting wrestlers every game, Heya! Sumo Manager has endless replayability and excitement as you build your legacy!

Features:

  • 3D Match Engine with a complex and detailed Commentary system

  • Create your avatar as an Oyakata with a rich background that affects your entire game

  • Over 600 rikishi across 40+ stables

  • Accurate tournaments, divisions and banzuke generation in an endless simulation

  • 15 and 7 bout tournaments depending on division with playoffs, awards and win-loss records that affect promotion or demotion

  • Scope out your rikishi's opponents and decide on the best tactics for every match

  • Facilities management, improve your stables gym, kitchen, bedrooms and more to improve training

  • Scout and Recruit hot prospects locally, nationwide or worldwide

  • Over 100 events to keep things fresh and interesting

  • Hire and Fire staff to train, scout and cook for your rikishi

  • Balance training with keeping your Koenkai (supporter's club) happy and meet their demands

  • Handle interpersonal issues and the reputation of your stable

  • International wrestlers

  • All 82 kimarite

data.short_description: Heya! Sumo Manager allows you to manage a sumo stable and develop the skills of your rikishi on their road to Yokozuna! Climb from Jonokuchi to Sekitori by organizing the diet, training and tactics of your wrestlers and see them compete in 3D matches.
